sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Software Engineer / Senior Data Analyst
Virtusa Consulting Services – Hyderabad Client: HSBC (Financial Services) Jan 2022 – Present
Project: Finance on the Cloud (FOTC) – Global finance data transformation initiative.
Key Responsibilities:
Supported large-scale financial data transformation programs across enterprise
finance systems.
Worked within Agile, cross-functional teams to design and deliver governed,
high-quality data solutions.
Led business, functional, and non-functional requirement elicitation with
finance stakeholders.
Translated business requirements into conceptual, logical, and physical data
models aligned with governance standards.
Designed reconciliation-ready data structures to support financial reporting and
controls.
Performed metadata analysis, including entity definitions, attribute naming, data
types, lengths, and lineage.
Produced and owned data modeling artifacts, mapping documents, and
analysis deliverables for development teams.
Acted as a bridge between Business, Finance, and IT, ensuring requirement
clarity throughout the SDLC.
Supported end-to-end data journey mapping, from source systems through
transformation to consumption layers.
Used SQL and BigQuery extensively for data analysis, validation, and
reconciliation checks.
Ensured traceability and consistency of data and metadata across
environments.
Senior Data Analyst / BI Analyst
Keolis Hyderabad Mass Rapid Transit System Ltd – Hyderabad Client: L&T Metro Rail Limited Dec 2017 – Jan 2022
Key Responsibilities:
Gathered and analyzed business and technical requirements for enterprise
reporting and analytics.
Designed logical and physical data models to support operational and
management reporting.
Created source-to-target mappings, transformation rules, and business logic
documentation.
Performed data gap analysis and impact assessments across multiple source
systems.
Built and maintained analytics-ready data marts for reporting and reconciliation.
Conducted time-series and trend analysis on transactional datasets.
Developed KPI definitions and ensured alignment between business metrics and
underlying data models.
Worked closely with stakeholders to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and
usability.
Data Analyst
Concentrix – Visakhapatnam Client: Uber International Apr 2017 – Nov 2017
Key Responsibilities:
Analyzed high-volume transactional datasets including trips, demand, and fare
data.
Created analytical data models to support business reporting and forecasting.
Used SQL for data analysis, validation, and reconciliation.
Developed KPI frameworks and reporting structures aligned with business
objectives.
Translated functional requirements into scalable analytical datasets.
